lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Carhenge redevelopment — it hits two separate bodies on Tuesday, September 30: HARC takes up preliminary large-scale applications for the proposed new construction at 700 W. Pacific, and Town Council holds a special appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that P&Z approved back in July. Meanwhile, Mountain Village Council convenes Friday in an all-day executive session to work out terms for a new Town Manager, and the Gondola Leadership Committee meets Sunday to weigh a consequential choice between federally funded and locally-led project delivery.
